fichas.title: Retail outlets: waiting zones and food-shop ranges
fichas.summary: Guidance for retail formats that combine shopping with on-site consumption or take-away. The page describes impulse-buying strategies, daily fresh-stock deliveries, minimal customer sanitary facilities, and sales-area ranges for several food-shop types.
